title: Meeting Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Sonny White at a fusion conference

tellings.quote: All I was going to say was uh I was I was uh I was in graduate school doing uh uh pulse icy fusion work when uh I went to a conference to present. I was introduced to Eric Davis, how put off young uh and Sunny White and

plain: Years ago, as a graduate student working on pulsed fusion research, Michels' co-host met three men at a fusion conference where he had come to present his work: the physicists Eric Davis and Hal Puthoff, and the engineer Harold "Sonny" White. The co-host goes only by the name Jack and has spent years working in defense and aerospace. He brings up the meeting in passing on the show, as the moment he was first introduced to the three.
